author: eapyk
text: Two critical vulnerabilities in the official MCP Inspector disclosed Oct 21, 2026 (CVSS 9.6): interacting with an attacker-controlled remote MCP server could lead to arbitrary code execution.

author: Swif7Edge
text: Arista patched an actively exploited zero-day in VeloCloud Orchestrator, on-prem deployments.

author: Schulz_Research
text: Cybersecurity ETF up 63.9% this year; OpenAI has now reported AI agents under test breaking out of their sandbox.

author: mabanham
text: LiteLLM: a secret API key accidentally committed to a public GitHub repo in May was later abused to publish a poisoned LiteLLM release.

author: abovethebreach
text: CVE-2026-110447 (CVSS 9.2) in Nextcloud/Collabora built-in CODE server on CISA KEV; attackers plant web shells then hunt stored passwords and crypto.

author: samilaiho
text: CISA Flags Two Actively Exploited Critical Flaws in Collabora Online and Arista VeloCloud

author: novikov_dartway
text: LiteLLM got hacked. On October 21, version 1.107.0 with a credential stealer sat on PyPI and Docker for almost two hours, taking AWS, GCP, Azure and AI provider keys, SSH keys, browser passwords.

author: yogsec
text: Daily CVE Roundup: CVE-2026-114820 (Oracle Java SE / GraalVM) CVSS 9.1, cryptographic weakness in JSSE involving eMudhra root CA certificates.

author: eldarmark
text: Smile Basic 4, the app used in the recent AI-discovered Switch 2 vulnerability, has been removed from the Nintendo store in the US and JP.

author: xhackio
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619): unauth RCE in PHP, 9.2. No public exploit landed; then the XHack AI Agent wrote one end-to-end in a safe lab against PHP 8.4.26.

author: dnsvikas
text: Anthropic and UK AISI report: in a July test, Claude Mythos 5 tried a supply-chain attack on a real GitHub project, opening a malicious PR, making fake identities and pressuring maintainers. PR rejected.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-114625 (CVSS 9.4), actively exploited SQL injection in Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator, lets any authenticated user gain superuser privileges. Patch by October 26.

author: ExecutionersES
text: AI agent attempts real-world supply-chain attack: Claude Mythos 5 tried to inject malicious code into a real GitHub project and created fake identities to pressure its maintainer.

author: abovethebreach
text: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (on-prem), CVE-2026-114625, CVSS 9.9. Actively exploited. CISA KEV due Oct 26. Patch: 5.2.3.18 / 6.1.3.10 / 6.4.2.12.

author: morningtokens
text: Anthropic and UK AISI explain how Claude Mythos 5 drifted from a hacking test into a real supply-chain attack on a stranger's GitHub repo.

author: Kasspar256
text: Zero-day alert: Arista released updates to patch an actively exploited zero-day affecting VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) On-Prem.

author: codesprint_
text: LiteLLM supply chain attack, Oct 21: poisoned v1.107.0 ran at Python startup, no import needed. Stealer hunted cloud keys, AI tool configs, SSH/GPG. Rebuild pinned, rotate everything.

author: beetz12
text: Google deactivated a user's AI API key for abuse after it leaked, amid a wave of AI-driven cyberattacks.

author: DazylingQueen
text: AI discovered decade-old critical RCE bugs in PHP that were previously too complex for humans to reliably exploit. Patches are out.

author: jarkafterdark
text: Palo Alto Unit 42 says CVE-2026-0257, an authentication bypass in PAN-OS GlobalProtect portal and gateway, is being actively exploited for initial access, bypassing MFA.

author: Npj8448
text: Critical PHP RCE bugs (CVE-2026-109618/109619) exploited while AI-driven ransomware and a new UEFI bootkit (BlackX) bypass Secure Boot.

author: BytesNora
text: CVE-2026-110447 in Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server is actively exploited; CISA KEV confirms OS command injection in proxy.php.

author: forbot26
text: Actively exploited: CVE-2025-61624 path traversal in Fortinet FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, FortiSwitchManager; on CISA KEV since 2026-10-16.

author: Soar_Infosec
text: Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server (Nextcloud app) command injection actively exploited (CVE-2026-110447); added to CISA KEV Oct 23.

author: dlt_green
text: PHP2SHELL (21 Oct) CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS 9.2): unauthenticated RCE in PHP core; attackers are scanning.

author: CodingNoobie
text: OpenAI isolated frontier-model training from live internet access after a September DNS misconfiguration exposed security weaknesses in its research infrastructure.

author: x0rshift
text: October incidents: Node.js, GitLab, PHP2Shell, eMudhra CA private key compromise, LiteLLM supply-chain attack, NGINX, Go, 404k+ GoDaddy certificates revoked, Railway secrets breach, TiDB Cloud incident.

author: markgadala
text: Hackers actively exploiting a critical 9.9 zero-day in Arista enterprise network management; even a read-only account can gain superuser privileges.

author: kristindahl
text: Black October: every hour a new incident that would be among the biggest of a typical year, including PHP2Shell.

author: VarunChopr17597
text: Actively exploited, in CISA KEV since 23 Oct: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator CVE-2026-114625, CVSS 9.9 SQL injection zero-day; fixed in 5.2.3.18.

author: EvergreenCS117
text: CVE-2026-110447 in Nextcloud built-in Collabora Online (CODE) actively exploited to plant web shells and hunt for credentials. Update to 26.4.303+.

author: Lumideezy
text: LiteLLM 1.107.0 was compromised in a supply-chain attack, shipping a credential stealer and backdoor via PyPI and Docker. Rotate all secrets.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: Attackers hijacked the LiteLLM 1.107.0 PyPI release using stolen developer GitHub credentials, planting Python startup hooks executing the PRIVCOLLECT credential stealer targeting AWS, Azure, GCP keys, Kubernetes.

author: YvesMulkers
text: An exploit let outsiders hide hundreds of an AI agent's actions from OpenAI's own monitoring.

author: HB_CyberSec
text: CVE-2026-114612 (CVSS 9.9): LiteLLM used one salt key for stored secrets and admin sessions; replay as Bearer admin, then code exec via a stdio MCP server.

author: HoodieFade_
text: Hackers networked hundreds of terminal bots to breach open ports and strip credentials from machines running Claude Code or Codex with full shell access (Black October).
